messages:
sarah: Quick preflight — we plan a "lite" canary tomorrow 09:30PT for kernel+quant changes (kernel v2.14-q, quant profile qprof-lite-2026). Goal: validate perf reg & KV cache stability on a 5% canary slice. please confirm readiness and rollback hooks.

alex: I can own the rollout window. Confirming rollout ops steps: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full. each step has a 15m observation window. rollback script is ready. :thumbsup:

maria: PR #4821 is green, perf bench passed on colab infra. LGTM. small note: removed a noisy debug log.

jin: traffic split for canary is set via routing policy rsplit-2026, currently mapped to slot sb-lite-03. We need to ensure autoscaler is disabled for the slot for the window.

alex: autoscaler will be pinned to min=1 for sb-lite-03 during the window. rollback command (dry-run):
```
./ops/rollback.sh --slot sb-lite-03 --to-tag v2.13-stable --dry-run
```
real rollback: drop --dry-run and monitor.

tomas: Who's running smoke checks? I can run the infra-side smoke script and the kv-priming job. Smoke checklist:
- health endpoints (200)
- kv cache hit rate sanity
- p99 latency within 10%
- demo prompt correctness (small eval)

sarah: assign smoke -> tomas (infra), alex (runtime), jin (routing). target smoke start: 09:25PT, 5m smoke then flip canary at 09:30.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary slice sb-lite-03 reserved for 2038764512 rollout by alex. snapshot id: snap-2026-033.

tomas: smoke command I'll run (copy):
```
./tools/smoke_check.sh --slot sb-lite-03 --kernel-tag v2.14-q --quant qprof-lite-2026 --checks health,kv,p99,eval --timeout 300
```

maria: added a tiny eval set to the run: evals/mini-regressions/2026-lite.json — covers core failure modes.

jin: alerting hooks: paging enabled for p99>1200ms or kv-hit<60%. dashboards: https://console.redwood/sb-lite-03/dashboards/rollout (internal).

alex: rollback readiness: we have prebuilt v2.13-stable image and quant profile qprof-prod-2025 pinned. I verified rollback takes ~2m to rebind in canary slot.

sarah: ok. final micro-checklist before smoke go:
- alex: slot pinned + rollback script tested
- tomas: smoke command queued and can run at 09:25PT
- jin: alerts/dashboards linked and routing pinned
- maria: PR merged + eval set attached
If all good, start smoke at 09:25 and I'll kick canary at 09:30. react here when done. :rocket:

alex: done (slot pinned, rollback dry-run ok).

maria: merged and eval attached.

tomas: smoke done locally, passing (health ok, kv 82% hit, p99 +6%). attaching snippet: `RESULT: PASS small-eval: OK`

jin: routing pinned and alerts active.

sarah: thanks all. I'll wait 5m for any late flags then start canary. if anything weird, respond here ASAP.

alex: noted, standing by on pager.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary started for sb-lite-03 at 2038764660. monitor logs and metrics.

sarah: canary started — watching dashboards.

maria: eyeballing logits distributions with the quick viz — no shift visible in first 200 samples.

tomas: noise in worker 7's kernel logs, raising a follow-up but not blocking; p99 still within threshold.

sarah: good. escalating if anything changes. rollback plan remains the same. thanks everyone. :heart:
